`pr.merged_by_human` → `PrMergedByHuman`, 70 variants over lanes 1–8) plus
`Unknown { raw_type: String }`. Methods: `prd_name(&self) -> Cow<str>` returns the dotted PRD name
(`"finding.blocking"`, `"unknown.event"`); `lane(&self) -> Option<Lane>` returns the PRD lane for
known kinds and `None` for `Unknown` (the session role decides). Serde `[arch decision]`: default
externally tagged with `rename_all = "snake_case"` (`"finding_blocking"`,
`{"unknown":{"raw_type":"todo_state"}}`); derive guarantees the round trip, `prd_name()` is for
display, CLI and the store `kind` column.

`MappingVersion` (`mapping/version.rs`): `enum MappingVersion { V1 }`, serde `"v1"`,
`MappingVersion::LATEST`, `fn for_droid_version(v: &str) -> (MappingVersion, Option<Warning>)` (§5).

Serde rules: all enums `snake_case`; ids `#[serde(transparent)]`; `Timestamp` RFC 3339 with
milliseconds, UTC (`2026-10-22T14:54:47.240Z`); `duration` as `duration_ms: u64`; unknown JSON
fields are rejected on `Event` (`deny_unknown_fields`) so a golden file drift fails loudly.
Test `event_round_trips_through_serde()` covers an event per `SourcePtr` variant and `Unknown`.

## 4. Ingest (`core::ingest`)

### 4.1 Source trait and RawRecord

```rust
pub struct RawRecord { pub ptr: SourcePtr, pub session_id: SessionId, pub bytes: Vec<u8> /* one line, no newline */ }
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)] #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SourceKind { Jsonl, Rpc, Git, GitHub }

pub trait Source {
    fn kind(&self) -> SourceKind;
    /// Pull the next records. Returns an empty Vec when nothing new is available right now.
    /// Never blocks longer than one poll interval; never returns an error for "no data".
    fn next_batch(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<RawRecord>, IngestError>;
    /// True when every known file has been read to its current end (replay = attach that reached EOF, D-008).
    fn at_eof(&self) -> bool;
}
```

`[arch decision]` `next_batch` + `at_eof` replace SPEC §5.4's `poll`: the name says it pulls, and
`at_eof` is what makes replay and attach one code path (the CLI stops at `at_eof()`, the watcher keeps
calling). `IngestError` (thiserror): `Io { path, source }`, `FileMoved { path }`, `TooLarge { path, mb }`.

### 4.2 JsonlSource (S; sidecar and children M0)

```rust
pub struct JsonlSource { /* files: Vec<TailState { path, session_id, offset: u64, partial: Vec<u8> }>, cfg: IngestConfig */ }
impl JsonlSource {
    pub fn open(root: &Path, cfg: &IngestConfig) -> Result<Self, IngestError>;   // root = the orchestrator .jsonl
    pub fn add_file(&mut self, path: &Path) -> Result<SessionId, IngestError>;   // child or newly discovered file
    pub fn read_at(path: &Path, byte_offset: u64, byte_len: u32) -> Result<Vec<u8>, IngestError>; // used by inspect/Details
}
```

Reading rules: open read-only; read from `offset` in chunks of `tail_chunk_kb`; split on `\n`; an
incomplete trailing fragment stays in `partial` until the newline arrives (a writer may be mid-line);
`byte_offset` is the offset of the first byte of the line, `byte_len` excludes the newline; a line
that is not valid JSON is still a `RawRecord` (mapping yields `Unknown { raw_type: "<unparseable>" }`).
Files over `max_session_file_mb` are indexed and a `TooLarge` warning is surfaced once.

Sidecar `<session-id>.settings.json` (`ingest::sidecar`, fields fixed by planning note 1 and verified on
disk 2026-10-22):

```rust
pub struct Sidecar {
    pub model: Option<String>, pub reasoning_effort: Option<String>, pub interaction_mode: Option<String>,
    pub autonomy_level: Option<String>, pub tags: Option<Vec<String>>, pub assistant_active_time_ms: Option<u64>,
    pub token_usage: Option<SidecarUsage>,          // inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadTokens, cacheCreationTokens,
                                                    // thinkingTokens, factoryCredits
    pub inclusive_token_usage: Option<SidecarUsage>, pub last_call_token_usage: Option<SidecarUsage>,
    pub child_inclusive_token_usage_by_session_id: BTreeMap<String, SidecarUsage>,
}
pub fn read_sidecar(jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<Option<Sidecar>, IngestError>; // None when the sibling is absent
```

Unknown keys are ignored (the file carries many more: `systemPrompt`, `enabledToolIds`, ...). The
`systemPrompt` value is never logged or stored.

Child discovery (M0): a session directory is scanned for `*.jsonl`; each file's first line is parsed
as `session_start` (`id`, `callingSessionId`, `callingToolUseId`, `cwd`, `version`); a file whose
`callingSessionId` equals a known session id is a child and is added with `parent_id`. The root is
the file with no `callingSessionId`. Fixture layout mirrors this:

```text
fixtures/streams/2026-10-22-observatory-v1-m0.jsonl                    orchestrator session (byte-identical copy)
fixtures/streams/2026-10-22-observatory-v1-m0.capture.json             fixture header (below)
fixtures/streams/2026-10-22-observatory-v1-m0.events.json              golden lane events (§5)

```

`.jsonl` stays a byte-identical copy and every `byte_offset` in the golden file equals the offset in

  "source_dir": "~/.factory/sessions/-Users-dct-code-EllyaOrg-projects-dalimaray-droid-observatory",

### 4.3 Watcher (M1, feature `watch`)

```rust
pub struct SessionWatcher { /* notify::RecommendedWatcher + poll fallback */ }
impl SessionWatcher {
    pub fn start(cfg: &IngestConfig) -> Result<Self, IngestError>;  // scans cfg.factory_sessions_dir recursively
    pub fn next_discovered(&mut self) -> Vec<DiscoveredSession>;    // new *.jsonl since last call (notify or poll)
}
pub struct DiscoveredSession { pub path: PathBuf, pub session_id: SessionId, pub parent: Option<SessionId>,
                               pub name: String /* first tag, else session id (FR-L1) */ }
```

Design: `notify` 8.2.0 (FSEvents) for create/modify; a poll every `jsonl_poll_ms` (500) re-stats every
watched file and lists the directory, because FSEvents coalesces and a file created before start would be
missed (PRD §14). Startup scan attaches files modified in the last 24 h as growing [arch decision: a
bound so a directory with hundreds of old sessions does not open them all; older files stay in the
library and open on demand]. At most `max_watched_sessions` (64) files are tailed, newest first; the
UI shows "N sessions not watched". Growth is read by `JsonlSource::next_batch` in one `tail_chunk_kb`
step per poll. Everything runs on one `std::thread` owned by the shell (`backend.rs`), which batches
events toward the UI every `event_batch_ms` (100).

### 4.4 Capture header for live attach

`captures` row per attached directory: `id`, `source_dir`, `droid_version`, `started_at`. No file is
written next to Droid's files.

### 4.5 RpcSource (M2, feature `rpc`)

The shell spawns `droid exec --mission --input-format stream-jsonrpc --output-format stream-jsonrpc
<flags from the launch screen> -f <mission file>` with `tokio::process` (stdin piped, stdout piped,
stderr to a log). Every stdout line is appended verbatim to the spool
`~/.droid-observatory/hosted/<launch-id>.jsonl` `[arch decision]`: a hosted stream exists nowhere else,
`inspect`/Details need a raw line, and the spool is the raw source for `SourcePtr::Rpc` (it is not a
copy of a Droid file). `RpcSource` is a `JsonlSource` over the spool (same tail code, I3 holds).
Control writes go to stdin as JSON-RPC 2.0 requests:

```rust
pub enum HostControl { Pause, Resume, Message { text: String }, Answer { question_id: String, text: String },
                       Approve { request_id: String }, Deny { request_id: String } }
pub struct RpcRequest { jsonrpc: "2.0", id: u64, method: String, params: serde_json::Value }
pub fn encode(c: &HostControl, id: u64) -> RpcRequest;   // method names are confirmed in M2 from `droid exec --help`
                                                         // and the first hosted capture; recorded in the M2 decision file
```

An acknowledgement is the JSON-RPC response with the same `id`; `pause_request_is_written_as_jsonrpc_and_acknowledged()`
asserts it. The child is in its own process group and is killed on window close
(`child_process_is_reaped_on_window_close()`); the readiness report shows why: killing the parent alone
orphans children (`trunk serve` and the app binary reparented to PID 1 in the Tauri run).

### 4.6 GitSource, GitHubSource and the Forge trait (M4)

```rust
pub trait Forge {
    fn pr(&self, branch: &str, target: &str) -> Result<Option<Pr>, ForgeError>;
    fn checks(&self, pr: &Pr) -> Result<Vec<Check>, ForgeError>;      // Actions runs + commit statuses, never check-runs
    fn policy(&self, target: &str) -> Result<MergePolicy, ForgeError>; // rulesets + branch protection
    fn reviews(&self, pr: &Pr) -> Result<Vec<Review>, ForgeError>;
    fn attestations(&self, pr: &Pr) -> Result<Vec<Attestation>, ForgeError>;
    fn merge(&self, pr: &Pr, method: MergeMethod) -> Result<Merged, ForgeError>;
}
pub struct Pr { pub number: u64, pub head_sha: String, pub head: String, pub base: String, pub url: String,
                pub state: PrState /* Open, Merged { by: MergedBy::Human | Policy, at }, Closed */ }
pub struct Check { pub name: String, pub source: CheckSource /* ActionsRun { run_id } | CommitStatus { context } */,
                   pub conclusion: CheckConclusion /* Queued, Running, Passed, Failed, RequiredMissing */, pub url: String }
pub struct MergePolicy { pub requires_human: bool, pub allowed_methods: Vec<MergeMethod>,
                         pub decided_by: RuleAttribution /* Ruleset { id, name } | BranchProtection | ConfigOverride(String) | NoRule */ }
pub enum ForgeError { Forbidden { pr: u64, target: String, missing_permission: &'static str /* "pull_requests:write" */ },
                      RateLimited { reset_at }, Http { status, url }, Other(String) }
```

`GitHubSource` uses the token from `secrets::github_token()` (§12), base `https://api.github.com`,
endpoints: `GET /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls?head={o}:{branch}&base={target}&state=all`,
`GET /repos/{o}/{r}/actions/runs?head_sha=`, `GET /repos/{o}/{r}/commits/{sha}/status`,
`GET /repos/{o}/{r}/rules/branches/{target}` and `GET /repos/{o}/{r}/rulesets`,
`GET /repos/{o}/{r}/branches/{target}/protection` (404 → no protection),
`GET /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}/reviews`, `GET /repos/{o}/{r}/attestations/{subject-digest}` (best effort),
`PUT /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}/merge`. The check-runs API is never called (planning note 6). Poll every
`[github].poll_interval_s` (30). HTTP client: `ureq` 3 (blocking, rustls) `[arch decision]`: core has
no tokio (I1); version verified on the day with `make deny`. `GitSource` runs `git` via
`std::process::Command` in the repository: `for-each-ref refs/heads/mission/*`, `worktree list --porcelain`,
`log --first-parent --merges mission/<name>` for integration commits → `IntegrationMerged`; fast-check
runs come from `GET /actions/runs?branch=mission/<name>` → `GateCommandRun/Passed/Failed` attributed to
the milestone whose `wt/<m>` merge commit is the run's head.

Target branch comes from `[github].target_branch` (default `"main"`, §11); the mission branch from
`[mission].branch_pattern`. Merge policy: `[github].merge_policy = "auto"` reads GitHub (`requires_human`
= ruleset/protection requires a PR and no auto-merge is enabled); `"human"` forces the button;
`"policy"` never shows it (`decided_by = ConfigOverride`). Gate badge state machine (`view::gate`):
`Pending` (no PR) → `ChecksRunning` → `ReviewRequested` | `HumanRequired` | `RulesetBlocked` | `CiRed` →
`CiGreen` → `PolicyMerged` | `MergedByHuman`. `PolicyMerged` is set when the poll sees `state = Merged`
with no app merge action in `human_actions` for that PR (`policy_merged_detected_without_human_action()`).

Merge button flow (planning note 7): visible only when `requires_human && all required checks Passed`
(`merge_button_shows_only_when_policy_is_human_and_checks_are_green()`); click → confirmation dialog
naming `PR #n` and `target`; confirm → `control::merge` writes the lane-7 `PrMergedByHuman` intent row
with `state = requested`, calls `Forge::merge`; on `ForgeError::Forbidden` the UI shows exactly
`Merge of PR #<n> into <target> refused: token lacks <missing_permission>. Merge in GitHub; the badge
updates from the next poll.`; no retry, the row becomes `state = refused`, the button stays visible, the
poll continues at the normal interval (no storm). The owner merges; the next poll yields `PolicyMerged`
or `MergedByHuman` depending on the merger login equalling the token owner.

## 5. Mapping (`core::mapping`)

```rust
pub struct MapContext<'a> { pub session: &'a SessionMeta /* id, role, parent, model, mission_id */, pub version: MappingVersion }
pub fn map_record(rec: &RawRecord, ctx: &MapContext) -> Vec<Event>;   // total: ≥ 1 event, never panics
pub fn select_version(droid_version: Option<&str>) -> (MappingVersion, Option<Warning>);
```

Version selection: `0.247.*` → `V1`; any other or `None` → `LATEST` with
`Warning::UnknownDroidVersion { seen, used }` printed once by the CLI and shown once in the UI status bar
(SPEC §5.2). `mapping_version_is_selected_by_droid_version()` reads it from `capture.json`.

`mapping::v1` input shapes (observed in `~/.factory/sessions/…` on 2026-10-22, keys only; M0 confirms
and freezes): line `type` ∈ `session_start`, `message`, `todo_state`, `agent_turn_outcome`,
`compaction_state`. `message` lines: `{id, parentId, seq, timestamp (RFC 3339), message: {role: user|assistant,
content: [ {type: text|thinking|tool_use|tool_result, ...} ], modelId?, apiProvider?, reasoningEffort?}}`.
`tool_use` parts: `{id, name, input}`; `tool_result`: `{tool_use_id, content, is_error?}`. Tool names seen:
`Task`, `Execute`, `Script`, `Read`, `Edit`, `Create`, `Grep`, `Glob`, `LS`, `TodoWrite`, `AskUser`,
`ProposeMission`, `Skill`, `FetchUrl`, `WaitForScript`, `ApplyPatch`.

v1 rules (the frozen table lives in `mapping/v1/kinds.rs` and is reproduced in the M0 decision file):

| Raw shape | EventKind | Lane / role |
|---|---|---|
| `session_start` with no `callingSessionId` | `IntentCreated` (first) | 1, Orchestrator |
| `session_start` with `callingSessionId` | `SubagentSpawned` | 3, child's role |
| user `message`, text, root session, first | `IntentCreated`; later ones `IntentAmended` | 1, Human |
| assistant `tool_use` name `Task` | `TaskAssigned` (+ `FeatureDefined` when the input names a new feature) | 2 |
| assistant `tool_use` name `ProposeMission` | `PlanCreated`; `MilestoneDefined` per milestone in the input | 2 |
| assistant `tool_use` name `AskUser` | `QuestionAsked` | 1 |
| user `tool_result` for an `AskUser` | `IntentAnswered` | 1, Human |
| assistant `tool_use` Execute/Script with `git commit` in the command | `CommitCreated` | 3 |
| assistant `tool_use` Execute/Script with `cargo test`/`make test`/`make check` | `TestsRun`; result `is_error` → `GateCommandFailed` else `GateCommandPassed` when the command is `make check` | 3 / 6 |
| assistant `tool_use` Edit/Create/ApplyPatch | `FileTouched` | 3 |
| `tool_result` with `is_error: true` | `ToolError` (`HookBlocked` when the content names `guard-git.sh`) | 3 |
| assistant message whose `modelId` differs from the previous assistant message of the session | `ModelChanged` | 3 |
| `compaction_state` | `ContextCompacted` | 2 |
| `agent_turn_outcome` in a child session | `TaskDone` (`resultKind`), then `SubagentFinished` at EOF | 3 |
| `todo_state` | `PlanRevised` when todos changed | 2 |
| validator text containing a `## Blocking`/`## Non-blocking` findings block (format fixed in M0 from the capture) | `FindingBlocking` / `FindingNonBlocking` / `ScrutinyPassed`; user-testing `QaScenarioPassed/Failed/Evidence` | 4 / 5 |
| sidecar `tokenUsage` (per session, emitted once at EOF or when it changes) | `UsageReported` with `TokenUsage` | 3 (role's lane) |
| anything else | `Unknown { raw_type: "<type>" or "<type>/<content type>/<tool name>" }` | `Lane::for_role(role)` |

Role resolution (`mapping/v1/roles.rs`), in order: (1) no `callingSessionId` → `Orchestrator`;
(2) the parent's `tool_use` part whose `id == callingToolUseId` has `input.subagent_type` (observed:
`worker`); `worker` → `Worker`, values containing `scrutiny` → `ScrutinyValidator`, `user` + `test` →
`UserTestingValidator` (exact strings fixed in M0); (3) `tags` entry `role:<x>`; (4) else `Unresolved`.
Ids (`mapping/v1/ids.rs`): `mission_id` = root session id; `milestone_id`/`feature_id` from the `Task`
input's `description`/title matched against the `ProposeMission` plan (M0 fixes the exact fields).
Model = assistant `modelId`, else sidecar `model`.

Golden tests (`tests/mapping.rs`): for each `fixtures/streams/*.capture.json`, map the capture with the
header's version and compare to `<...>.events.json` (array of `Event`, paths relative to repo root,
ordered by `(at, session_id, byte_offset, sub)`); regenerate only with
`OBSERVATORY_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p observatory-core --test mapping` and a reviewer read.
PRD §7 kinds not produced from the M0 capture are listed as "defined, not observed" in
`docs/decisions/D-0NN-mapping-v1.md`, with `every_prd_kind_present_in_capture_is_mapped()` asserting the
complement.

## 8. Control (`core::control`, M3)

```rust
pub enum HumanAction { Pause, Resume, Message { text_len: u32 }, Answer { question_event: EventId, text_len: u32 },
                       Approve { request_event: EventId }, Deny { request_event: EventId },
                       MarkComplete { feature_id: FeatureId }, MarkSkipped { feature_id: FeatureId, reason_len: u32 } }
pub fn record(action: &HumanAction, mission: &MissionId, at: Timestamp, action_id: u64) -> Event;
   // kind: Pause/Resume → MissionPaused/MissionResumed (lane 2, role Human? no: lane 7 ApprovalGiven? see table)
```

Lane-7 mapping (`each_control_emits_one_lane7_event_with_actor_human()`): every action produces exactly one
event with `lane = Human`, `role = Human`, `source = App { action_id }`: Pause/Resume → `ReviewOutcome`?
No: `[arch decision]` lane 7 has five PRD kinds; controls map as Pause/Resume/Message/MarkComplete/
MarkSkipped → `ApprovalGiven` with `target` in `human_actions.kind` naming the control, Answer →
`QuestionAnswered`, Approve/Deny → `ApprovalGiven`/`ApprovalRequested`-closing `ApprovalGiven` with
`state = denied` in the row, Merge → `PrMergedByHuman`. Reason: the PRD fixes lane-7 kinds and forbids
inventing new ones; the control name lives in the `human_actions` row the pointer references. Text is
never stored (only its length); it is relayed to the host over `HostControl` (M2) and, for attach-only
missions, shown as "copy to the terminal running the mission" (no control channel, D-008).

Stall (`control::stall`): `pub fn evaluate(features: &[FeatureActivity { feature_id, last_active_at, last_kind }],
now, threshold: Duration) -> Vec<StallFlag { feature_id, idle_for, runbook: RunbookPrompt }>`; threshold =
`[intervention].stall_threshold_min` (20). Nothing under threshold is reported (FR-H6,
`no_alert_for_waits_under_threshold()`). `RunbookPrompt` follows `docs/runbooks/stalled-mission.md`:

| `last_kind` | Prompt (anchor in `stalled-mission.md`) |
|---|---|
| `QuestionAsked`, `PermissionRequested` | "Waiting on human: answer it" (#waiting-on-human) |
| `SubagentSpawned` with no child growth | "Worker silent: check the child file, retry or skip" (#worker-silent) |
| `HookBlocked` repeated | "Agent hits the write guard: forward-only instruction" (#hook-blocked) |
| `IntegrationConflict` | "Two worktrees touched one file" (#integration-conflict) |
| anything else | "Long tool call: wait one more threshold, then pause and inspect" (#long-tool-call) |

## 9. Metrics (`core::metrics`, M5)

Time states (PRD §10.1): `enum TimeState { Active, WaitingHuman(Question|Permission|Merge), WaitingValidation,
RetryFailure, IdleQueued, IdleUnscheduled }`. `pub fn partition(events_of_feature: &[Event], end: Timestamp)
-> Vec<Interval { from, to, state }>`, contiguous and non-overlapping
(`time_states_partition_every_instant_exactly_once()`). Active intervals `[arch decision]`: each event
with `duration` contributes `[at, at + duration]`; `duration` is set by the mapper as `tool_result.at -
tool_use.at` for tool calls and `assistant.at - previous_line.at` (same session) for model generation.
`ToolError`/`HookBlocked` intervals are `RetryFailure`; an open `QuestionAsked`/`PermissionRequested`/
green-but-unmerged gate with no active interval is `WaitingHuman`; `TaskDone` without a validator start is
`WaitingValidation`; a defined feature blocked by another's active interval is `IdleQueued`, else
`IdleUnscheduled`. The oracle (below) validates these rules.

Rework windows (`metrics::rework`): open/close pairs from PRD §10.2 (`FindingBlocking→ReworkResolved`,
`QaScenarioFailed→QaScenarioPassed` same scenario, `IntegrationConflict→IntegrationConflictResolved`,
`CheckFailed→CheckPassed` same check); overlapping windows on one feature merge; unresolved at mission end
reported with `closed_by = None`. Causes: `scrutiny`, `user_testing`, `integration`, `gate`.
Overhead (`metrics::overhead`): orchestrator intervals before the first `FeatureDefined`, replanning not
attributable, and compaction recovery; reported as its own line; `[metrics].overhead_apportionment =
"equal"` splits it and labels the output `apportioned`. Derived (`metrics::derived`): cycle (feature,
milestone, mission, per lane), waste by the 8 SPEC §5.6 causes, bottleneck (lane/role with highest
waiting + queued; lane with highest WIP/throughput), fix loops (count of `fix` cycles).

Cost (`metrics::cost`): tokens from `UsageReported` (sidecar `tokenUsage`); credits primary when
`factoryCredits` is present; otherwise `Σ tokens × per_m / 1e6` from `config/prices/<date>.toml`
(`[metrics].price_table`); every `Cost` carries `price_table: String` (the `effective` date)
(`cost_names_the_price_table_date()`). Budget meter: `[metrics].budget` or the launch `budget_usd`.
Model comparison (FR-M7): per role, per model, `cost_per_completed_feature` and
`first_pass_active_s_per_completed_feature`.

Oracle (`tests/oracle.rs`, `reports/reference/2026-10-22-observatory-v1-m0.csv`, owner-produced before M5).
Column contract `[arch decision]` (fixed now so the owner can produce it):

```text
scope,id,name,cycle_s,first_pass_active_s,rework_s,waste_waiting_human_question_s,waste_waiting_human_permission_s,
waste_waiting_merge_s,waste_waiting_validation_s,waste_rework_s,waste_retry_failure_s,waste_idle_queued_s,
waste_idle_unscheduled_s,rework_windows,tokens_input,tokens_output,tokens_cache_read,tokens_cache_write,cost_usd,price_table
```

`scope ∈ {feature, milestone}`; durations integer seconds; tolerance 1 s, 1 token, 0.01 USD
(`metrics_match_reference_spreadsheet_within_tolerance()`). `observatory-cli metrics <root.jsonl> --csv`
prints exactly these columns; `--json` prints `MetricsReport`. Export (`metrics::export`): same rows to
CSV (RFC 4180) or JSON at the chosen path.

## 16. Branch, worktree and integration flow

- Mission branch `mission/observatory-v1`; worktrees `/Users/dct/code/EllyaOrg/projects/dalimaray/observatory-wt/<m>`
  on `wt/<m>` for `<m>` ∈ `s, m0, m1, m2, m3, m4, m5`; symlink `observatory-wt/current` → active worktree
  (`services.yaml` commands use it).
- Workers and validators of `<m>` edit only inside `wt/<m>`; two worktrees never touch one file (rule 13).
  Shared files (`SPEC.md` §9–10, `README.md`, `BACKLOG.md`, `docs/decisions/README.md`,
  `reports/usage|readiness|ci`) are written only by the integration feature on the mission branch.
- First feature of each milestone after S is the integration feature (`integration-worker`): `git merge
  --no-ff wt/<prev>` into `mission/observatory-v1`, `make check`, push, wait for `mission-checks` green,
  write the shared files and the decision files due (S: mapping input/session schema, keyring variant B,
  backlog-is-BACKLOG.md, coverage, machete, read-only token), record the owner's unlocked-display
  screenshot path, remove the old worktree, create the new one, repoint `current`, return the boundary report.
- Forward only: no amend, reset, rebase, stash, force-push; fixes are new commits; co-author trailer on
  agent commits. Final M5 integration and the single PR `mission/observatory-v1` → `main` are the
  orchestrator's; the human merges after `gate` is green.
- Backlog is `BACKLOG.md` only (planning note 9). Throttle or cap: pause, write `reports/usage/`, stall flag,
  ask the owner; never a silent model or effort downgrade (note 8).

**Design choices made beyond what the sources fix (10 lines):**

1. Fixture header is a sidecar `<date>-<slug>.capture.json` (fields: `droid_version`, `captured_at`, `source_dir`, `sessions[{id, role, file}]`, `mapping_version`), not a first line, so the `.jsonl` stays byte-identical and golden `byte_offset`s match the live file.
2. `Source` trait is `next_batch() -> Result<Vec<RawRecord>>` plus `at_eof()`, replacing SPEC's `poll`; the CLI stops at EOF and the watcher keeps calling, which makes replay and attach literally one code path (D-008).
3. Core Cargo features (`store`, `watch`, `rpc`, `github`, `secrets`) with the UI depending on core `default-features = false`, so `model`/`mapping`/`view`/`metrics` compile to wasm and the browser host (`trunk serve` 3141, SPEC §6) can open a fixture through the file picker with a `BrowserBackend`; `TauriBackend` uses the same UI code.
4. `EventId` is deterministic `<session_id>:<byte_offset>:<sub>` (no hash crate); `MissionId` = root session id until M0 confirms where `--tag` lives; added `Role::Unresolved` so a child session whose role cannot be resolved stays visible and counted instead of being guessed.
5. `EventKind` serde is the derived externally-tagged `snake_case` form (`"finding_blocking"`, `{"unknown":{"raw_type":…}}`) with `prd_name()` for the dotted display/store name; `Event` uses `deny_unknown_fields` so golden drift fails loudly.
6. Hosted (M2) stdout lines are spooled verbatim to `~/.droid-observatory/hosted/<launch-id>.jsonl`, and `SourcePtr::Rpc { path, byte_offset, byte_len }` points into it, so `inspect`/Details have a raw line for RPC events without copying any Droid file.
7. HTTP client for GitHub is blocking `ureq` (core has no tokio); new config keys `[github].target_branch = "main"` and `[github].repo = "dctellya/droid-observatory"` so the target is parameterised as the M4 test demands; `[ingest].startup_scan_hours = 24` bounds the startup scan.
8. Lane-7 control events reuse only the five PRD kinds (`ApprovalGiven`, `QuestionAnswered`, `PrMergedByHuman`); the control name lives in `human_actions.kind`, free text is never stored (only its length).
9. The OTel exporter lives in `src-tauri/telemetry.rs` (tokio-flavoured SDK) while `core::telemetry` is pure (series plan, 182 worst case, label allow-list, `name=value` header split on the first `=`); Active time intervals come from mapper-set `duration` (tool_use→tool_result, previous line→assistant message), to be validated by the M5 oracle.
10. The oracle CSV column contract is fixed now (`scope,id,name,cycle_s,first_pass_active_s,rework_s,waste_*_s ×8,rework_windows,tokens_*,cost_usd,price_table`) so the owner can produce `reports/reference/2026-10-22-observatory-v1-m0.csv` before M5; coverage runs as a separate `coverage` CI job with `COVERAGE_MIN` (0 in S, 80 from M0) and a `make coverage` target kept out of `make check` because `cargo llvm-cov` must run alone.
